info.title: BytePlus ModelArk Video Generation (Seedance) API
info.description: Filtered OpenAPI description for the Seedance video generation proxy. The upstream endpoint is BytePlus ModelArk's asynchronous video generation task API (international, ap-southeast region); the caller selects the Seedance model via the request `model` field. Workflow: create a task, poll it until `status` is `succeeded`, then download the video from the temporary `content.video_url`.

post.description: Create an asynchronous video generation task with a caller-selected Seedance model. The response returns only the task id; poll the retrieve endpoint until the task reaches a terminal state. Generation parameters (resolution, ratio, duration, audio) are top-level fields for Seedance 2.0 models; Seedance 1.x models instead read `--resolution 1080p --ratio 16:9 --duration 5` style flags appended to the text prompt.

content.text: A quiet product demo shot, slow camera move, clean studio light

200.description: Task accepted. Poll the returned id for the result.

get.description: List video generation tasks, optionally filtered by status or model. Free endpoint used to reconcile task queues.

parameters.name: filter.status
parameters.description: Filter by task status (queued, running, succeeded, failed, cancelled, expired).

get.description: Retrieve a video generation task. While the task is queued or running the response has no `usage` and the upto charge settles as a full refund; the poll that returns `status: succeeded` includes `usage.total_tokens` (settled as the generation charge) and the temporary `content.video_url` download link. Stop polling after a terminal state — retrieving an already-succeeded task settles its usage again.

parameters.name: taskId
parameters.description: Task id returned by the create endpoint (e.g. "cgt-2026...").

delete.summary: Cancel or delete a video generation task
delete.description: Cancel a queued/running task or delete a finished one. Free endpoint.

parameters.name: taskId
parameters.description: Task id to cancel or delete.

model.description: Seedance model id selected by the caller (e.g. "dreamina-seedance-2-0-260128", "dreamina-seedance-2-0-fast-260128", "dreamina-seedance-2-0-mini-260615", "seedance-1-5-pro-251215", "seedance-1-0-pro-250528"). Model ids carry release-date suffixes that rotate — list current ids in the ModelArk console.

content.description: Multimodal generation inputs in order: a text prompt plus optional image/video/audio references (Seedance 2.0 supports image, video, and audio conditioning; 1.x supports text and first/last-frame images).

resolution.description: Output resolution (e.g. "480p", "720p", "1080p"). Seedance 2.0 top-level field; for 1.x models pass --resolution in the text prompt instead. Billing scales with pixel count.

duration.description: Video duration in seconds. Billing scales linearly with duration.

generate_audio.description: Seedance 2.0: also generate a synchronized audio track.

return_last_frame.description: Include the final frame image URL in the task result (useful for chaining shots).

watermark.description: Whether the output video carries the provider watermark.

callback_url.description: Upstream webhook invoked on task state changes. Note: callbacks bypass the proxy's usage settlement — callers paying per use should poll the retrieve endpoint instead.

type.description: Input kind. Exactly one matching payload field must be set.

text.description: Prompt text for "text" items. Seedance 1.x models also read generation flags appended here (e.g. "--resolution 1080p --duration 5").

url.description: HTTPS URL or data URI of the image.

role.description: How this input conditions the generation.

model.description: Model id that served the task.

video_url.description: Temporary download URL for the generated MP4 (expires; copy to durable storage promptly).

last_frame_url.description: Final frame image URL when return_last_frame was requested.

usage.description: Present when status is succeeded. total_tokens is the billed video token count: (width x height x 24fps x seconds) / 1024.
